verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's docs state that the Public API is OAS3-compatible and publishes a compliant swagger.json definition. The help site hosts Swagger UI over an embedded OpenAPI 3.0.4 document, with a self-hosted equivalent at /api/docs/, and the Vault Management API (`bw serve`) has its own embedded OpenAPI document. The probe's 404s on guessed root paths do not contradict the documented location. Missing for 10: no hands-on confirmation of a direct raw-file download URL (the spec is embedded and mounted client-side, and the old api.bitwarden.com/docs host is retired), and no independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The Public API is compatible with the OpenAPI Specification (OAS3) and publishes a compliant [`swagger.json`](/help/api/) definition file.
bitwarden.com/help/api/ vendor-hosts Swagger UI over the Public API's embedded OpenAPI 3.0.4 document (info title "Bitwarden Public API")
The Vault Management API page embeds its own OpenAPI document for the CLI's `bw serve` local server.
